Name: OrientOffset
Description: Applies a matrix orient offset setup to a list of custom controls.

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Applies the matrix orient offset setup to a custom list of controls.

How To Use:
  Select the controls in the scene and click 'Add Selected' below. Then click build.

Fields:
- SetControlsList: List of controls to process.
- AutoParentChildren: If true, existing children of the controls will be reparented under the new _Driven groups automatically.
- RemapScaleConnections: If true, detects direct scale connections going out of the control (e.g. multiplyDivide nodes from ScaleTweakCtrls) and remaps them through the orient rotation so scale axes match the new visual orientation.
- HideOrientAttrs: If true, the proxy orient attributes on the control will be hidden on build.
- LockOrientAttrs: If true, the proxy orient attributes on the control will be locked on build.
